Celebrations in Smoke#197.dst: Arris의 씨족에 대해 알 만한 사람을 찾으세요.

Celebrations in Smoke#198.src: I love being a part of the Kalkalrah clan, but at times like this it's nice to have the chance to be alone.
Celebrations in Smoke#198.dst: Kalkalrah 씨족의 일원인 게 좋지만, 이럴 땐 혼자 있을 기회가 있어 좋네요.
Celebrations in Smoke#198.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#199.src: Staring across the pond, enjoying the festival, surrounded by people I love.
Celebrations in Smoke#199.dst: 연못 건너편을 바라보며, 사랑하는 사람들과 축제를 즐기는 거죠.
Celebrations in Smoke#199.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#200.src: It's a sort of quiet, safe calm. One unlike the rest of the year.
Celebrations in Smoke#200.dst: 조용하고 안전한 평온함이랄까요. 다른 때와는 달라요.
Celebrations in Smoke#200.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#201.src: Hmm? Ah. Yes, unfortunately I do.
Celebrations in Smoke#201.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#202.src: They were a member of our clan until a week ago, when they were expelled and exiled.
Celebrations in Smoke#202.dst: 일주일 전까지는 우리 씨족원이었는데, 제명되고 추방당했어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#202.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#203.src: Their old medallion was handed to me to burn. In fact, just on my way into the festival I threw its ashes up the tallest tree in {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#203.dst: 그 사람의 옛 메달을 태우라고 제게 맡겼죠. 사실 축제에 오는 길에 그 재를 {p}에서 제일 높은 나무 위로 뿌렸어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#203.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#204.src: Interrogated them? Oh, I hope they haven't done anything bad.
Celebrations in Smoke#204.dst: 심문했다고요? 아, 나쁜 짓을 안 했어야 할 텐데.
Celebrations in Smoke#204.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#205.src: You know, they were always a bit troubled. But I don't think they're bad. They just weren't suited for clan life.
Celebrations in Smoke#205.dst: 늘 좀 문제가 있긴 했어요. 그래도 나쁜 사람은 아니에요. 씨족 생활이 안 맞았을 뿐이죠.
Celebrations in Smoke#205.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#207.src: The fate they were given will be a hard one though. Most exiles don't survive a year.
Celebrations in Smoke#207.dst: 하지만 받은 운명은 가혹할 거예요. 추방자 대부분은 1년을 못 버티거든요.
Celebrations in Smoke#207.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#208.src: Not as much as I wish you could. Please treat them with kindness though, they only lie out of fear.
Celebrations in Smoke#208.dst: 바라는 만큼은 못 알려 드려요. 그래도 친절하게 대해 주세요. 두려워서 거짓말하는 거니까요.
Celebrations in Smoke#208.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#209.src: I do not mean to be rude, but you cut an imposing figure. There's a lot to be afraid of.
Celebrations in Smoke#209.dst: 무례하려는 건 아니지만, 당신은 위압적으로 보여요. 두려울 게 많은 세상이죠.
Celebrations in Smoke#209.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#210.src: I hope they stays well, even if they are troubled.
Celebrations in Smoke#210.dst: 문제가 좀 있더라도 무사히 지냈으면 좋겠어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#210.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#211.src: No no no, that isn't true at all.
Celebrations in Smoke#211.dst: 아뇨 아뇨 아뇨, 전혀 사실이 아니에요.
Celebrations in Smoke#211.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#212.src: I have no idea who or what you were talking to but I can assure you I, uh, was not exiled from my clan very recently.
Celebrations in Smoke#212.dst: 누구랑 무슨 얘길 하셨는지 모르겠지만, 전, 어, 최근에 씨족에서 추방당하지 않았어요. 확실해요.
Celebrations in Smoke#212.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#213.src: You don't have any proof of it, right? Right? So it's my word against theirs, there is no reason to believe anything that they have to say over me.
Celebrations in Smoke#213.dst: 증거는 없으시죠? 그렇죠? 그럼 제 말과 그 사람 말뿐이니, 제 말보다 그쪽 말을 믿을 이유가 없어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#213.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#214.src: I'm an, um, ordinary clan member who got caught up in something that I do not understand.
Celebrations in Smoke#214.dst: 전, 음, 이해도 안 되는 일에 휘말린 평범한 씨족원이에요.
Celebrations in Smoke#214.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#215.src: Search the tallest tree in {p} for Arris's burnt medallion.
Celebrations in Smoke#215.dst: {p}에서 가장 높은 나무를 뒤져 Arris의 불탄 메달을 찾으세요.

Celebrations in Smoke#218.src: Yes I was exiled from my clan and yes I did lie to you but I promise I didn't do anything else bad.
Celebrations in Smoke#218.dst: 네, 씨족에서 추방당했고 거짓말도 했어요. 하지만 맹세코 다른 나쁜 짓은 안 했어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#218.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#219.src: I don't know who burned down the wickerman but it wasn't me, you have to believe me.
Celebrations in Smoke#219.dst: 누가 위커맨을 태웠는지 몰라도 전 아니에요. 믿어 주셔야 해요.
Celebrations in Smoke#219.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#220.src: I only lied because I panicked and I'm sorry for panicking but please please please you cannot tell them that I'm a changeling or whatever.
Celebrations in Smoke#220.dst: 당황해서 거짓말한 거고 그건 죄송해요. 하지만 제발 제발 제발 제가 변신자라든지 그런 말은 하지 마세요.
Celebrations in Smoke#220.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#222.src: Because they all thought I stole something! Even though I promise, I promise I didn't.
Celebrations in Smoke#222.dst: 다들 제가 뭘 훔쳤다고 생각했으니까요! 맹세코, 맹세코 안 훔쳤는데도요.
Celebrations in Smoke#222.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#223.src: I was supposed to be keeping watch over our clan's stores. And I don't know how, but a box of our special green tea went missing.
Celebrations in Smoke#223.dst: 전 씨족 창고를 지키는 담당이었어요. 그런데 어째선지 특제 녹차 한 상자가 없어졌어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#223.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#224.src: I promise I didn't steal it, I really do. But none of them believed me, it somehow disappeared.
Celebrations in Smoke#224.dst: 맹세코 제가 안 훔쳤어요, 정말로요. 근데 아무도 안 믿었어요. 그냥 사라졌는데.
Celebrations in Smoke#224.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#225.src: They said I had lost years of trust with them, over something I swear I didn't do, and kicked me out.
Celebrations in Smoke#225.dst: 안 했다고 맹세한 일 때문에 오랜 신뢰를 잃었다면서 절 내쫓았어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#225.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#226.src: Since then, I've been having to find my own way to survive. I've, uh, not been very good at that.
Celebrations in Smoke#226.dst: 그 뒤로 혼자 살아남을 방법을 찾아야 했어요. 전, 어, 그걸 잘 못했어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#226.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#227.src: Maybe a week? I- I- I'm not exactly sure. It has been difficult keeping track of time.
Celebrations in Smoke#227.dst: 일주일쯤요? 저- 저- 정확히는 몰라요. 날짜 세기가 힘들었거든요.
Celebrations in Smoke#227.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#228.src: Yes! I've never lost anything like that before and I definitely haven't stolen anything ever at all.
Celebrations in Smoke#228.dst: 네! 그런 걸 잃어버린 적도 없고 뭘 훔친 적은 더더욱 절대 없어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#228.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#229.src: ... Although, I was caught sleeping while on watch a few times. And my clan got really upset with me for that, even though I promise nothing bad happened.
Celebrations in Smoke#229.dst: ... 다만, 보초 서다가 자는 걸 몇 번 들킨 적은 있어요. 씨족이 그걸로 엄청 화냈어요. 맹세코 나쁜 일은 없었는데도요.
Celebrations in Smoke#229.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#230.src: I wasn't trying to sleep, but it's so hard to stay up all night while nothing is happening.
Celebrations in Smoke#230.dst: 자려던 건 아닌데, 아무 일도 없는데 밤새 깨어 있기가 너무 힘들어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#230.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#232.src: Oh, uh, well you know. I was, um.
Celebrations in Smoke#232.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#234.src: And this was the only place I could think of that would have any and I really missed not having to run across the {p} trying to forage and I really really hate being exiled and I need somewhere to go.
Celebrations in Smoke#234.dst: 먹을 게 있을 만한 곳이 여기밖에 생각이 안 났고 {p}을(를) 뛰어다니며 먹을 걸 찾지 않던 때가 정말 그립고 추방당한 게 너무너무 싫고 갈 곳이 필요했어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#234.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#235.src: Sorry, I didn't mean to dump all my troubles on you.
Celebrations in Smoke#235.dst: 죄송해요, 제 고민을 다 떠넘기려던 건 아니에요.
Celebrations in Smoke#235.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#237.src: Um. If it wouldn't be too much to ask.
Celebrations in Smoke#237.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#238.src: Would you mind getting me a Fortune Cookie?
Celebrations in Smoke#238.dst: 포춘 쿠키 하나만 가져다주실 수 있어요?
Celebrations in Smoke#238.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#239.src: I don't want to burden you or anything and I know I just lied to you and you're trying to investigate me for a horrible crime, but I'm really hungry and didn't get a chance to eat before you all shoved me in here.
Celebrations in Smoke#239.dst: 폐 끼치고 싶진 않고 방금 거짓말한 것도 알고 끔찍한 범죄로 저를 조사 중인 것도 알지만, 너무 배고파요. 여기 밀려 들어오기 전에 먹을 틈도 없었어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#239.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#240.src: Thank you so so so so much.
Celebrations in Smoke#240.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#241.src: Thank you! I don't think I've had one of these since I was a kid.
Celebrations in Smoke#241.dst: 고마워요! 어릴 때 이후로 이런 걸 먹어 본 적이 없는 것 같아요.
Celebrations in Smoke#241.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#242.src: Here, let me read my fortune to you.
Celebrations in Smoke#242.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#243.src: "Beware some of those closest to you! They may not be what they seem."
Celebrations in Smoke#243.dst: "가장 가까운 이들 중 몇을 조심하라! 보이는 것과 다를지니."
Celebrations in Smoke#243.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#244.src: That, uh, would have been more useful a couple weeks ago.
Celebrations in Smoke#244.dst: 그거, 어, 몇 주 전에 봤으면 쓸모 있었겠네요.
Celebrations in Smoke#244.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#246.src: Sorry. Please don't think I did whatever I can tell you think I did.
Celebrations in Smoke#246.dst: 죄송해요. 제가 했다고 생각하시는 거, 딱 보이는데, 그러지 마세요.
Celebrations in Smoke#246.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#247.src: Thank you! I don't think I've had one of these since I was a kid.
Celebrations in Smoke#247.dst: 고마워요! 어릴 때 이후로 이런 걸 먹어 본 적이 없는 것 같아요.
Celebrations in Smoke#247.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#248.src: Here, let me read my fortune to you.
Celebrations in Smoke#248.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#249.src: "Beware some of those closest to you! They may not be what they seem."
Celebrations in Smoke#249.dst: "가장 가까운 이들 중 몇을 조심하라! 보이는 것과 다를지니."
Celebrations in Smoke#249.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#250.src: That, uh, would have been more useful a couple weeks ago.
Celebrations in Smoke#250.dst: 그거, 어, 몇 주 전에 봤으면 쓸모 있었겠네요.
Celebrations in Smoke#250.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#251.src: Burick. I'm simply a humble green tea trader.

Celebrations in Smoke#252.src: I don't know what happened, I wasn't involved, and that's all I have to say.
Celebrations in Smoke#252.dst: 무슨 일인지 모르고, 난 관련 없소. 할 말은 그게 다요.
Celebrations in Smoke#252.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#254.src: I found this burnt medallion, confirming what I was told by a former clan member of yours. You were exiled for theft.
Celebrations in Smoke#254.dst: 이 불탄 메달을 찾았어. 네 옛 씨족원에게 들은 얘기가 사실이었어. 넌 도둑질로 추방당했지.

Celebrations in Smoke#255.src: That should be enough to go off if you can find someone who buys a lot of green tea. If you want to get more information though, you can continue the interrogation.
Celebrations in Smoke#255.dst: 녹차를 많이 사는 사람을 찾을 수 있다면 이 정도로 충분할 것이다. 하지만 더 많은 정보를 원한다면 심문을 계속할 수 있다.

similar.text: That should be enough to go off if you can find someone who was observant enough to see Cerisa sneak in. If you want to get more information though, you can continue the interrogation.

Celebrations in Smoke#256.src: One clan wants to get rid of stuff, while another clan wants to get their hands on it.
Celebrations in Smoke#256.dst: 한 씨족은 물건을 처분하고 싶고, 다른 씨족은 그걸 손에 넣고 싶어 하지.
Celebrations in Smoke#256.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#257.src: The {p} is a big and dangerous place. They need a trader to make it happen.
Celebrations in Smoke#257.dst: {p}은(는) 넓고 위험하오. 그러니 거래를 이어 줄 상인이 필요하지.
Celebrations in Smoke#257.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#258.src: Yes. Someone has to do it though.
Celebrations in Smoke#258.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#259.src: Nope. And neither has anyone else I've spoken to.
Celebrations in Smoke#259.dst: 아니. 내가 얘기해 본 누구도 본 적 없소.
Celebrations in Smoke#259.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#260.src: I'm not even certain they're real.
Celebrations in Smoke#260.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#262.src: Don't mention to anyone else that I said that.
Celebrations in Smoke#262.dst: 내가 그렇게 말했다고 아무한테도 말하지 마시오.
Celebrations in Smoke#262.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#263.src: Some people get really upset when you imply that.
Celebrations in Smoke#263.dst: 그런 식으로 넌지시 말하면 정말 화내는 사람들이 있소.
Celebrations in Smoke#263.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#264.src: The Kalkalrah clan sells it to me. So wherever they get it, I suppose.
Celebrations in Smoke#264.dst: Kalkalrah 씨족이 내게 팔지. 그러니 그들이 구하는 곳에서 오겠지.
Celebrations in Smoke#264.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#265.src: Yes. That's what a merchant is.
Celebrations in Smoke#265.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#266.src: I'm not a member of any clan. I travel around selling my products.
Celebrations in Smoke#266.dst: 난 어느 씨족에도 속하지 않소. 떠돌며 물건을 팔지.
Celebrations in Smoke#266.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#267.src: Clan life would be too stifling. I like getting to see more than the trunk of a single tree.
Celebrations in Smoke#267.dst: 씨족 생활은 너무 답답하오. 나무 한 그루 줄기보다 더 많은 걸 보고 싶소.
Celebrations in Smoke#267.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#270.src: I'm a merchant, not a member of a clan.
Celebrations in Smoke#270.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#271.src: I don't have a way to get one and it hasn't been a problem.
Celebrations in Smoke#271.dst: 구할 방법이 없는데, 딱히 문제된 적도 없소.
Celebrations in Smoke#271.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#272.src: I walked closely behind a group that did.
Celebrations in Smoke#272.dst: 메달 있는 무리 바로 뒤에 붙어 들어왔소.
Celebrations in Smoke#272.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#274.src: Gives me a good chance to investigate the green tea market too.
Celebrations in Smoke#274.dst: 녹차 시장을 살펴볼 좋은 기회이기도 하고.
Celebrations in Smoke#274.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#276.src: Trades were handled quickly, while the other parties were heavily armed, and in small enough quantities that if I was a changeling no major loss would be incurred.
Celebrations in Smoke#276.dst: 거래는 빨리 끝났고, 상대는 중무장했고, 내가 변신자라 해도 큰 손실이 없을 만큼 적은 양이었소.
Celebrations in Smoke#276.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#278.src: I did not and I would not hazard a guess as to who did.
Celebrations in Smoke#278.dst: 난 안 했고, 누가 했는지 추측도 하지 않겠소.
Celebrations in Smoke#278.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#279.src: I am answering your questions to the best of my knowledge and ability.
Celebrations in Smoke#279.dst: 아는 한, 할 수 있는 한 질문에 답하고 있소.
Celebrations in Smoke#279.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#280.src: Isn't it your job to figure that stuff out?
Celebrations in Smoke#280.dst: 그걸 알아내는 게 당신 일 아니오?
Celebrations in Smoke#280.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#281.src: I see no reason to do your own work and give you more rope to hang me with.
Celebrations in Smoke#281.dst: 당신 일을 대신해서 날 목매달 밧줄을 더 줄 이유는 없지.
Celebrations in Smoke#281.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#283.src: I'm cooperating. But I don't see why I should trust someone I don't know or trust with more details than they need.
Celebrations in Smoke#283.dst: 협조하고 있소. 하지만 모르는 사람을 믿고 필요 이상으로 말할 이유는 모르겠소.
Celebrations in Smoke#283.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#284.src: It would be helpful for my business if you just let me go.
Celebrations in Smoke#284.dst: 그냥 풀어 주면 내 장사에 큰 도움이 되겠지.
Celebrations in Smoke#284.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#285.src: But I'm not demanding that. You can give me the same etiquette.
Celebrations in Smoke#285.dst: 하지만 요구하는 건 아니오. 당신도 같은 예의를 지켜 주시오.
Celebrations in Smoke#285.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#287.src: Sure, but I have no use for your emeralds.
Celebrations in Smoke#287.dst: 그러지. 하지만 당신 에메랄드는 필요 없소.
Celebrations in Smoke#287.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#288.src: It's been a while since I've had some rabbit roast. Get some of that for me and I'll see what I can do.
Celebrations in Smoke#288.dst: 토끼 구이를 먹어 본 지 오래됐소. 그걸 좀 사다 주면 뭘 해 줄 수 있을지 보지.
Celebrations in Smoke#288.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#289.src: Huh. I didn't think you actually would, thanks.
Celebrations in Smoke#289.dst: 허. 진짜 사 올 줄은 몰랐소, 고맙소.
Celebrations in Smoke#289.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#290.src: Anyway, I'm terse because I'm used to being. It doesn't really have anything to do with you.
Celebrations in Smoke#290.dst: 아무튼, 말이 짧은 건 버릇이라 그렇소. 당신 때문은 아니오.
Celebrations in Smoke#290.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#291.src: I spend so much time alone by myself in the woods that I'm not used to making conversation, even when it's needed.
Celebrations in Smoke#291.dst: 숲에서 혼자 지내는 시간이 길다 보니, 필요할 때도 대화가 익숙하지 않소.
Celebrations in Smoke#291.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#292.src: Sorry, you seem nice, I wish I could be of more use to your investigation.
Celebrations in Smoke#292.dst: 미안하오, 좋은 사람 같은데. 조사에 더 도움이 되면 좋겠소.
Celebrations in Smoke#292.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#293.src: I have enough of them as is.
Celebrations in Smoke#293.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#294.src: Most of the time I trade in kind anyway.
Celebrations in Smoke#294.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#298.src: I don't know and you're not getting a guess out of me.
Celebrations in Smoke#298.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#299.src: I could have missed something, but I didn't see any of us do it.
Celebrations in Smoke#299.dst: 놓친 게 있을 수도 있지만, 우리 중 누가 하는 건 못 봤소.
Celebrations in Smoke#299.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#300.src: Find someone who might be familiar with a green tea merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#300.dst: 녹차 상인을 알 만한 사람을 찾으세요.

Celebrations in Smoke#301.src: It's the festival again! And you know what that means...
Celebrations in Smoke#301.dst: 또 축제다! 그게 무슨 뜻인지 알지...
Celebrations in Smoke#301.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#302.src: Green tea!!! I never know how to get this stuff outside the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#302.dst: 녹차!!! 축제 말고는 이걸 어디서 구하는지 모르겠어.
Celebrations in Smoke#302.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#303.src: I'm going to spend all night standing right here, drinking as much of it as I can!
Celebrations in Smoke#303.dst: 오늘 밤 내내 바로 여기 서서 최대한 많이 마실 거야!
Celebrations in Smoke#303.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#305.src: Please, tell me, I would love to know. I've been searching for one for years.
Celebrations in Smoke#305.dst: 제발 알려 줘, 정말 알고 싶어. 몇 년째 찾고 있거든.
Celebrations in Smoke#305.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#306.src: The closest I got was some odd tent in the woods east of {p} with a box of the stuff, but that just a scavenger's tent.
Celebrations in Smoke#306.dst: 제일 가까웠던 건 {p} 동쪽 숲의 이상한 천막에 녹차 한 상자가 있던 건데, 그냥 떠돌이 채집꾼 천막이었어.
Celebrations in Smoke#306.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#307.src: I wish the Kalkalrah clan wouldn't keep the secret so well hidden.
Celebrations in Smoke#307.dst: Kalkalrah 씨족이 비밀을 그렇게 꼭꼭 숨기지 않으면 좋겠는데.
Celebrations in Smoke#307.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#308.src: No, of course not. They keep it a secret, hoarding it up all year, so they can charge us extra during the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#308.dst: 아니, 당연히 아니지. 비밀로 하고 1년 내내 쌓아 뒀다가 축제 때 비싸게 받거든.
Celebrations in Smoke#308.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#309.src: They do all this under the guise of it being "mystical" and "only suited for ceremonial occasions like this," but everyone sees through their sales techniques.
Celebrations in Smoke#309.dst: "신비로운" 거라서 "이런 의식 때만 어울린다"는 핑계를 대는데, 다들 그 장사 수법을 꿰뚫어 보고 있어.
Celebrations in Smoke#309.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#310.src: ... not that it stops me from buying every bottle I can get my hands on. It feels amazing.
Celebrations in Smoke#310.dst: ... 그래도 손에 넣을 수 있는 건 한 병도 빠짐없이 사지만. 기분이 끝내주거든.
Celebrations in Smoke#310.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#311.src: Okay, you have to be holding out on me.
Celebrations in Smoke#311.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#312.src: Come on, give me the name. What do you want, emeralds? Information? I'll give it to you, just tell me where I can find a year round green tea merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#312.dst: 이봐, 이름 좀 알려 줘. 뭘 원해, 에메랄드? 정보? 다 줄게, 1년 내내 녹차 파는 상인이 어디 있는지만 말해 줘.
Celebrations in Smoke#312.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#313.src: What are you wasting my time for then?
Celebrations in Smoke#313.dst: 그럼 왜 내 시간을 낭비하는 건데?
Celebrations in Smoke#313.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#314.src: If you get any leads on that tea trader, make sure to let me know right away.
Celebrations in Smoke#314.dst: 그 차 상인에 대해 단서를 찾으면 바로 알려 줘.
Celebrations in Smoke#314.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#315.src: You must not have spoken to the people I sold to then.
Celebrations in Smoke#315.dst: 그럼 내가 판 사람들과는 얘기를 안 해 봤나 보군.
Celebrations in Smoke#315.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#316.src: Not sure how much of an enthusiast they could be if they don't know me.
Celebrations in Smoke#316.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#317.src: Even so, that's only the words of one person. I won't pretend to know everyone in the {p}. Even the ones I do meet I don't make a major impression on.
Celebrations in Smoke#317.dst: 그렇다 해도 한 사람 말일 뿐이오. {p}의 모든 사람을 안다고 하진 않겠소. 만난 이들에게도 인상이 남진 않고.
Celebrations in Smoke#317.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#319.src: Search for a camp east of {p} [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] that Burick might have been spotted at.
Celebrations in Smoke#319.dst: Burick이 목격됐을 만한 {p} 동쪽 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 야영지를 뒤지세요.

Celebrations in Smoke#321.src: What else would I need? I'm sure while you were violating my privacy you snooped through my stuff. I have nothing to hide.
Celebrations in Smoke#321.dst: 내게 뭐가 더 필요하겠소? 사생활을 침해하면서 내 물건도 뒤졌을 텐데. 숨길 건 없소.
Celebrations in Smoke#321.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#322.src: There simply isn't much excess gear that I need as a merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#322.dst: 상인에겐 여분의 장비가 그다지 필요 없소.
Celebrations in Smoke#322.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#325.src: You're not believing that, are you.
Celebrations in Smoke#325.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#326.src: Fine. I'm not really a merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#326.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#327.src: I'm a scavenger. I was born without a clan and have lived my entire life without one.
Celebrations in Smoke#327.dst: 난 떠돌이 채집꾼이오. 씨족 없이 태어나 평생을 씨족 없이 살았소.
Celebrations in Smoke#327.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#328.src: When pressed, I pose as a merchant. I've spent enough time wandering the {p} that I have enough knowledge to be one.
Celebrations in Smoke#328.dst: 추궁당하면 상인 행세를 하지. {p}을(를) 오래 떠돌아서 상인 노릇 할 만큼은 아오.
Celebrations in Smoke#328.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#329.src: Still though, that's all. I won't pretend I didn't lie to you, but beside that I'm telling the truth.
Celebrations in Smoke#329.dst: 그래도 그게 다요. 거짓말한 건 인정하지만, 그 외엔 사실만 말하고 있소.
Celebrations in Smoke#329.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#330.src: I don't know who tried to burn down the wickerman or why. It certainly wasn't me.
Celebrations in Smoke#330.dst: 누가 왜 위커맨을 태우려 했는지 모르오. 확실히 난 아니오.
Celebrations in Smoke#330.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#331.src: There's not much to do out in the wilderness. Only so many times I can forage the same bush for food or admire the same river.
Celebrations in Smoke#331.dst: 황야에선 할 일이 별로 없소. 같은 덤불에서 먹을 걸 찾고 같은 강을 감상하는 것도 한도가 있지.
Celebrations in Smoke#331.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#332.src: I get lonely. I still am lonely.
Celebrations in Smoke#332.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#333.src: The festival is the only time of year I really get to be with others, I've been attending for years now.
Celebrations in Smoke#333.dst: 다른 이들과 함께할 수 있는 건 1년에 축제 때뿐이라, 몇 년째 오고 있소.
Celebrations in Smoke#333.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#334.src: Not that I can speak to anyone much. They might realize I'm not supposed to be here.
Celebrations in Smoke#334.dst: 그렇다고 누구와 많이 말할 순 없지. 내가 여기 있으면 안 된다는 걸 눈치챌 테니.
Celebrations in Smoke#334.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#335.src: How did you actually get in?
Celebrations in Smoke#335.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#336.src: I've managed to find a spot in the {p} wall where you can leap over and the guards can't see. I'm amazed they haven't fixed it yet.
Celebrations in Smoke#336.dst: {p} 벽에 뛰어넘을 수 있고 경비병도 못 보는 곳을 찾았소. 아직도 안 고친 게 놀랍군.
Celebrations in Smoke#336.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#337.src: Come to think of it, if someone else was coming here uninvited, that's probably how they got in too.
Celebrations in Smoke#337.dst: 생각해 보니, 초대받지 않은 누가 또 왔다면 아마 그쪽으로 들어왔겠지.
Celebrations in Smoke#337.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#338.src: I found it lying on the ground a few weeks ago, cracked open and half empty.
Celebrations in Smoke#338.dst: 몇 주 전에 땅에 떨어져 있었소. 금이 가서 반쯤 비어 있었지.
Celebrations in Smoke#338.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#339.src: Someone must have lost it or something, maybe a patrol of soldiers? That would be odd though, they're usually quite tidy.
Celebrations in Smoke#339.dst: 누가 잃어버렸나 보오. 순찰병일까? 그건 좀 이상하군. 보통 꽤 깔끔하니까.
Celebrations in Smoke#339.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#340.src: It could have been one of the clans too. At least one of them knows how to produce the stuff.
Celebrations in Smoke#340.dst: 씨족 중 하나일 수도 있소. 적어도 한 씨족은 그걸 만들 줄 아니까.
Celebrations in Smoke#340.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#341.src: I don't know, but I'm glad I found it! It's been too long since I've managed to drink any.
Celebrations in Smoke#341.dst: 모르겠지만, 주워서 다행이오! 못 마신 지 너무 오래됐거든.
Celebrations in Smoke#341.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#342.src: I hope you didn't confiscate it while you were snooping through my home.
Celebrations in Smoke#342.dst: 내 집을 뒤지면서 그걸 압수하진 않았길 바라오.
Celebrations in Smoke#342.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#343.src: My parents were exiled, I think?
Celebrations in Smoke#343.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#344.src: I've never really gotten the entirety of that story, so I'm unsure.
Celebrations in Smoke#344.dst: 그 이야기를 전부 들은 적은 없어서 확실하진 않소.
Celebrations in Smoke#344.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#345.src: I don't really feel like going deeper into it than that.
Celebrations in Smoke#345.dst: 그 이상 깊이 얘기하고 싶진 않소.
Celebrations in Smoke#345.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#346.src: It's nice to meet you too. I'm Cerisa, a petty thief.

Celebrations in Smoke#347.src: I snuck into the festival to snag shiny trinkets and whatever else I could get my hands on.
Celebrations in Smoke#347.dst: 반짝이는 장신구랑 손에 넣을 수 있는 건 뭐든 챙기려고 축제에 숨어들었죠.
Celebrations in Smoke#347.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#348.src: I was also completely uninvolved in who or what tried to burn down the wickerman, so you can let me go whenever you're ready to.
Celebrations in Smoke#348.dst: 그리고 누가, 혹은 뭐가 위커맨을 태우려 했든 저와는 전혀 무관하니, 준비되시면 언제든 풀어 주세요.
Celebrations in Smoke#348.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#349.src: Did you have anything else you wanted to know?
Celebrations in Smoke#349.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#350.src: Because you'd figure it out one way or another, I don't have a more respectable occupation to cover it up with that you wouldn't quickly disprove.
Celebrations in Smoke#350.dst: 어차피 어떻게든 알아내실 테니까요. 금방 들통나지 않을 번듯한 직업으로 둘러댈 수도 없고요.
Celebrations in Smoke#350.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#351.src: It'd be irrational to hide my criminal nature when that is precisely what you're searching for.
Celebrations in Smoke#351.dst: 당신이 찾는 게 바로 범죄자인데 제 범죄 성향을 숨기는 건 비합리적이죠.
Celebrations in Smoke#351.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#352.src: If I deceived you and you found out, you would surely take it as evidence that I had even more to hide.
Celebrations in Smoke#352.dst: 제가 속였다가 들키면, 분명 숨길 게 더 있다는 증거로 받아들이실 테니까요.
Celebrations in Smoke#352.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#353.src: My solitary purpose right now is to convince you that I did not try to burn the effigy. I can deal with the consequences of being exposed as a thief later.
Celebrations in Smoke#353.dst: 지금 제 유일한 목적은 제가 그 인형을 태우려 하지 않았다고 설득하는 거예요. 도둑으로 드러난 대가는 나중에 치르면 되고요.
Celebrations in Smoke#353.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#354.src: Of course not, that would be contrary to my overall purpose.
Celebrations in Smoke#354.dst: 물론 아니죠, 그건 제 목적에 어긋나니까요.
Celebrations in Smoke#354.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#355.src: Mind you, I don't expect you to believe me when I say that. You should definitely act as though I am lying to you.
Celebrations in Smoke#355.dst: 그렇다고 이 말을 믿어 주길 바라진 않아요. 당연히 제가 거짓말한다고 여기고 행동하셔야죠.
Celebrations in Smoke#355.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#356.src: But I won't. You trusting me is my best ticket out of this mess.
Celebrations in Smoke#356.dst: 하지만 안 할 거예요. 당신의 신뢰가 이 곤경을 벗어날 최선의 길이니까요.
Celebrations in Smoke#356.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#357.src: I do. I have no idea what they'd do to me and I don't want to find out.
Celebrations in Smoke#357.dst: 무서워요. 저한테 무슨 짓을 할지 전혀 모르고, 알고 싶지도 않아요.
Celebrations in Smoke#357.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#358.src: From what I was able to overhear between you and the organizer, it sounds like you're looking for a changeling.
Celebrations in Smoke#358.dst: 당신과 주최자의 대화를 엿들어 보니, 변신자를 찾고 계신 것 같더군요.
Celebrations in Smoke#358.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#359.src: And based on what they do to just an effigy of a changeling, I have absolutely no desire to find out what would happen to me if they actually thought I was one.
Celebrations in Smoke#359.dst: 변신자 인형에게조차 그런 짓을 하는 걸 보면, 정말 저를 변신자로 여기면 무슨 일이 생길지 전혀 알고 싶지 않아요.
Celebrations in Smoke#359.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#360.src: I'll take whatever punishment my thievery gets me and move on.
Celebrations in Smoke#360.dst: 도둑질에 대한 벌은 뭐든 받고 넘어갈게요.
Celebrations in Smoke#360.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#361.src: Of course, I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#361.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#363.src: Of course. I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#363.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#364.src: Yes. Being outside of a clan, there's no one particularly trustworthy in the {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#364.dst: 네. 씨족 밖에 있으면 {p}에서 딱히 믿을 만한 사람이 없거든요.
Celebrations in Smoke#364.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#365.src: With the changelings, even if I were to find a partner, I don't know how to make medallions and so could never be sure they weren't killed and replaced.
Celebrations in Smoke#365.dst: 변신자들이 있으니 동료를 찾아도 전 메달을 만들 줄 몰라서, 그 사람이 죽고 바꿔치기당하지 않았는지 확신할 수 없죠.
Celebrations in Smoke#365.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#366.src: It's much easier this way, I assure you.
Celebrations in Smoke#366.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#367.src: Whoever I can. For the most part it's the clans, they can be shockingly lazy if you know where you're looking.
Celebrations in Smoke#367.dst: 훔칠 수 있는 사람이면 누구든요. 대부분은 씨족이죠. 어디를 볼지 알면 놀랄 만큼 허술해요.
Celebrations in Smoke#367.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#368.src: I have stolen a bit from the military when their watch lapses, although that's obviously much harder to pull off.
Celebrations in Smoke#368.dst: 군의 경계가 느슨할 때 조금 훔친 적도 있어요. 물론 훨씬 어렵지만요.
Celebrations in Smoke#368.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#369.src: Not personally, no. I've heard some rumors though.
Celebrations in Smoke#369.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#370.src: Hard to tell fact from fiction, but they certainly seem to be a nasty bunch.
Celebrations in Smoke#370.dst: 사실과 허구를 구분하긴 어렵지만, 확실히 고약한 무리 같아요.
Celebrations in Smoke#370.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#371.src: I wouldn't be surprised to hear one tried to break into the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#371.dst: 그중 하나가 축제에 숨어들려 했다 해도 놀랍지 않네요.
Celebrations in Smoke#371.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#372.src: Of course, I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#372.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#373.src: Not directly, no. But of the three of us, I was the farthest from where the flame was kindled.
Celebrations in Smoke#373.dst: 직접 보진 못했어요. 하지만 우리 셋 중 불이 붙은 곳에서 제가 제일 멀었어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#373.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#374.src: I may have seen one of the other two suspects move, but I can't be positive about that.
Celebrations in Smoke#374.dst: 다른 용의자 둘 중 하나가 움직이는 걸 본 것도 같은데, 확신은 못 해요.
Celebrations in Smoke#374.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#375.src: If I had more information I would of course provide it.
Celebrations in Smoke#375.dst: 정보가 더 있다면 당연히 드릴 거예요.
Celebrations in Smoke#375.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#376.src: Ah, have you decided to try and play confrontational?
Celebrations in Smoke#376.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#377.src: That's fine, I will reiterate that I didn't do it. Whether you believe me or not, that is the truth.
Celebrations in Smoke#377.dst: 괜찮아요, 다시 말하죠. 전 안 했어요. 믿든 안 믿든 그게 진실이에요.
Celebrations in Smoke#377.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#378.src: My fate lies entirely in your hands, so to speak. You don't have to engage in theatrics to intimidate me, you are exactly as scary as you were before.
Celebrations in Smoke#378.dst: 말하자면 제 운명은 전적으로 당신 손에 있어요. 겁주려고 연기할 필요 없어요. 이미 충분히 무서우시니까요.
Celebrations in Smoke#378.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#379.src: Find someone who might have been observant enough to see Cerisa sneak in.
Celebrations in Smoke#379.dst: Cerisa가 몰래 들어오는 걸 봤을 만큼 눈썰미 좋은 사람을 찾으세요.

Celebrations in Smoke#380.src: Isn't it nice to see kids having fun?
Celebrations in Smoke#380.dst: 아이들이 즐거워하는 걸 보면 좋지 않나요?
Celebrations in Smoke#380.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#381.src: I try to lighten his life when I can, but it's so hard to some days.
Celebrations in Smoke#381.dst: 힘닿는 대로 아이 삶을 밝게 해 주려는데, 어떤 날은 정말 힘들어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#381.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#382.src: That's why I love the festival. Makes my job easier!
Celebrations in Smoke#382.dst: 그래서 축제가 좋아요. 제 일이 편해지거든요!
Celebrations in Smoke#382.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#383.src: He can entertain himself, I can watch for danger.
Celebrations in Smoke#383.dst: 아이는 알아서 놀고, 저는 위험을 살피면 되니까요.
Celebrations in Smoke#383.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#384.src: Nothing obviously dangerous, but I always keep in mind.
Celebrations in Smoke#384.dst: 딱히 위험한 건 없지만, 늘 신경은 써요.
Celebrations in Smoke#384.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#385.src: I did see something very odd a few hours ago though. By the entrance to {p}, it looked like someone hopped over the fence.
Celebrations in Smoke#385.dst: 그런데 몇 시간 전에 아주 이상한 걸 봤어요. {p} 입구 옆에서 누가 울타리를 넘는 것 같았어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#385.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#386.src: It might have been a trick of the light, but I think I saw them change clothes and shove something under the bridge.
Celebrations in Smoke#386.dst: 빛 때문에 잘못 본 걸지도 모르지만, 옷을 갈아입고 다리 밑에 뭔가 쑤셔 넣는 걸 본 것 같아요.
Celebrations in Smoke#386.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#387.src: Those might just be the ramblings of a worried old parent though!
Celebrations in Smoke#387.dst: 그냥 걱정 많은 늙은 부모의 헛소리일 수도 있지만요!
Celebrations in Smoke#387.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#388.src: Oh really? That's a shame, I thought I was stealthier than that.
Celebrations in Smoke#388.dst: 아 그래요? 아쉽네요, 그보단 은밀한 줄 알았는데.
Celebrations in Smoke#388.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#389.src: I'm not sure that's a real revelation though, I've been open to you that that's what I did.
Celebrations in Smoke#389.dst: 그게 대단한 폭로인지는 모르겠네요. 그렇게 했다고 처음부터 솔직히 말했잖아요.
Celebrations in Smoke#389.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#390.src: Is there anything else you wanted to call me to account for?
Celebrations in Smoke#390.dst: 그 밖에 따지고 싶은 게 더 있나요?
Celebrations in Smoke#390.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#391.src: Yes, I had a change in clothes. The clothes I wear on a daily basis are no fit for a cheerful atmosphere like the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#391.dst: 네, 갈아입을 옷을 가져왔어요. 평소 입는 옷은 축제처럼 즐거운 분위기에 안 어울리거든요.
Celebrations in Smoke#391.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#392.src: In that case, I appreciate you keeping me up to date on the progress of your investigation. Your commitment to transparency in the judicial process is admirable.
Celebrations in Smoke#392.dst: 그렇다면 조사 진행 상황을 계속 알려 주셔서 감사하네요. 사법 절차의 투명성에 대한 당신의 헌신은 존경스러워요.
Celebrations in Smoke#392.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#393.src: Search under the bridge around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for something Cerisa may have left behind.
Celebrations in Smoke#393.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 근처 다리 밑에서 Cerisa가 두고 간 물건을 찾으세요.

Celebrations in Smoke#395.src: That would be because it's mine.
Celebrations in Smoke#395.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#396.src: Your investigation is quite impressive, I'll admit. I was not expecting anyone to find those, I must not have disposed of them properly.
Celebrations in Smoke#396.dst: 조사 실력이 꽤 인상적이네요, 인정해요. 그걸 누가 찾을 줄은 몰랐어요. 제대로 처리하지 못했나 봐요.
Celebrations in Smoke#396.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#397.src: Although you did get a bit lucky, didn't you. If no one had spotted me sneak in, you never would have found them.
Celebrations in Smoke#397.dst: 그래도 운이 좀 좋으셨죠. 제가 숨어드는 걸 아무도 못 봤다면 절대 못 찾으셨을 거예요.
Celebrations in Smoke#397.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#398.src: I am a deserter from the military, as of a couple days ago. My stop here is a temporary respite to steal whatever I can before disappearing into the {p} as far as I can.
Celebrations in Smoke#398.dst: 전 며칠 전에 군에서 탈영했어요. 여기 들른 건 훔칠 수 있는 걸 훔치고 {p} 최대한 멀리 사라지기 전의 잠깐의 휴식이고요.
Celebrations in Smoke#398.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#399.src: No I didn't. I am a thief who came to the festival in part to steal petty trinkets. Nothing I told you was a lie.
Celebrations in Smoke#399.dst: 아뇨, 안 했어요. 전 자잘한 장신구를 훔치려고 축제에 온 도둑이기도 해요. 한 말 중에 거짓은 없어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#399.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#400.src: I'll grant that I did not tell you things you might have been interested in knowing, but that is only because you never asked about them.
Celebrations in Smoke#400.dst: 궁금하셨을 만한 걸 말하지 않은 건 인정해요. 하지만 그건 당신이 한 번도 묻지 않았기 때문이에요.
Celebrations in Smoke#400.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#401.src: Had you asked me if I was a former soldier, I would have provided you with all the information you are being given right now.
Celebrations in Smoke#401.dst: 전직 군인이냐고 물으셨다면, 지금 알려 드리는 정보를 전부 드렸을 거예요.
Celebrations in Smoke#401.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#402.src: Yes, it is to a degree. But you have to understand, you trusting me isn't my only strategy to get out of this.
Celebrations in Smoke#402.dst: 네, 어느 정도는요. 하지만 이해하셔야 해요. 당신의 신뢰만이 제가 빠져나갈 유일한 전략은 아니에요.
Celebrations in Smoke#402.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#403.src: It was a gamble to avoid mentioning my desertion. I had to weigh the odds of you finding evidence of my desertion with the danger I might be in by admitting to it.
Celebrations in Smoke#403.dst: 탈영을 말하지 않은 건 도박이었어요. 당신이 탈영 증거를 찾을 확률과, 인정했을 때 제가 처할 위험을 저울질해야 했죠.
Celebrations in Smoke#403.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#404.src: With hindsight, I bet wrongly, but I don't think my bet was irrational.
Celebrations in Smoke#404.dst: 돌이켜 보면 잘못 걸었지만, 비합리적인 도박은 아니었다고 생각해요.
Celebrations in Smoke#404.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#405.src: Had you been a worse investigator or gotten a bit less lucky, it would have paid off immensely.
Celebrations in Smoke#405.dst: 당신이 좀 더 서툰 조사관이었거나 운이 조금만 덜 좋았어도 크게 성공했을 거예요.
Celebrations in Smoke#405.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#406.src: And I trust that even now, you are a fair enough judicator you will look at the facts and only the facts.
Celebrations in Smoke#406.dst: 그리고 지금도 당신이 사실만, 오직 사실만 볼 만큼 공정한 판정자라고 믿어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#406.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#407.src: The facts that show I had nothing to do with what you're investigating.
Celebrations in Smoke#407.dst: 제가 조사 중인 일과 무관하다는 사실 말이에요.
Celebrations in Smoke#407.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#408.src: You could. And if you did you would be personally and entirely responsible for my death.
Celebrations in Smoke#408.dst: 그러실 수 있죠. 그렇게 하면 제 죽음은 전적으로 당신 개인의 책임이에요.
Celebrations in Smoke#408.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#409.src: Should you choose to, I hope my face haunts your nightmares for the rest of your life.
Celebrations in Smoke#409.dst: 그러기로 하신다면, 평생 제 얼굴이 악몽에 나타나길 바라요.
Celebrations in Smoke#409.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#410.src: But I don't think you will.
Celebrations in Smoke#410.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#411.src: I'll admit I struggle to express this in words, but you don't seem the type.
Celebrations in Smoke#411.dst: 말로 표현하긴 어렵지만, 그럴 사람으로는 안 보여요.
Celebrations in Smoke#411.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#412.src: You couldn't really go through with something like that.
Celebrations in Smoke#412.dst: 그런 일을 정말 해낼 수는 없으실 거예요.
Celebrations in Smoke#412.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#413.src: Of course, I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#413.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#414.src: Military life was too stifling for me. So many direct orders that I can do nothing but obey.
Celebrations in Smoke#414.dst: 군 생활은 제게 너무 답답했어요. 복종 말곤 할 수 없는 명령이 너무 많았죠.
Celebrations in Smoke#414.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#415.src: And it was so boring. Most of my time was spent standing still, watching for threats that never came.
Celebrations in Smoke#415.dst: 게다가 너무 지루했어요. 대부분 가만히 서서 오지도 않는 위협을 감시했죠.
Celebrations in Smoke#415.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#416.src: So I left. I wish them all the best and apologize to Her Majesty for my inability to serve her as I wanted to, but my time soured me on the whole affair.
Celebrations in Smoke#416.dst: 그래서 떠났어요. 모두 잘되길 바라고, 원했던 대로 여왕 폐하를 섬기지 못해 송구하지만, 그 시간 동안 완전히 질려 버렸어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#416.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#417.src: Oh, I see you're getting better at this.
Celebrations in Smoke#417.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#418.src: Yes, the other reason I left was the brutality of it. I do not handle blood well and was unprepared for the amount of blood I would see.
Celebrations in Smoke#418.dst: 네, 떠난 또 다른 이유는 그 잔혹함이었어요. 전 피를 잘 못 견디는데, 그렇게 많은 피를 볼 준비가 안 돼 있었어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#418.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#419.src: Most of the time, being a soldier is dull. Mind numbingly so. But the few times it was not made me wish more than anything in the world that I could be bored.
Celebrations in Smoke#419.dst: 군인은 대개 지루해요. 정신이 멍해질 만큼요. 하지만 지루하지 않았던 몇 번은, 세상 무엇보다 지루하길 바라게 만들었어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#419.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#420.src: I'm not even sure the violence was wrong, I just cannot participate in it.
Celebrations in Smoke#420.dst: 그 폭력이 잘못이었는지도 모르겠어요. 전 그저 거기 가담할 수 없을 뿐이에요.
Celebrations in Smoke#420.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#421.src: Unpleasant life at home. There was nothing for me to stay behind for. The military seemed like my best way out.
Celebrations in Smoke#421.dst: 집에서의 삶이 불행했어요. 남을 이유가 없었죠. 군대가 최선의 탈출구 같았어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#421.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#422.src: I think I would make the same choice again, even knowing how it would end. There's no way I could stay there for much longer.
Celebrations in Smoke#422.dst: 결말을 알았더라도 같은 선택을 했을 거예요. 거기 더 오래 머물 수는 없었으니까요.
Celebrations in Smoke#422.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#423.src: Of course, I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#423.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#424.src: Let me look at that more closely.
Celebrations in Smoke#424.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#425.src: No, I don't. The residue smells far more pungent than any drink I recognize.
Celebrations in Smoke#425.dst: 아뇨, 몰라요. 남은 냄새가 제가 아는 어떤 음료보다 훨씬 독하네요.
Celebrations in Smoke#425.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#426.src: If you found it here, you could try asking around the festival to see if anyone else recognizes it.
Celebrations in Smoke#426.dst: 여기서 찾으셨다면, 축제장에서 알아보는 사람이 있는지 물어보세요.
Celebrations in Smoke#426.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#428.src: Well, I can tell you it's not definitely not green tea. Not sure beyond that.
Celebrations in Smoke#428.dst: 음, 녹차가 아닌 건 확실해요. 그 이상은 모르겠네요.
Celebrations in Smoke#428.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#429.src: Hmm... neither of us have seen anyone carrying something that smells like that in.
Celebrations in Smoke#429.dst: 흠... 저런 냄새 나는 걸 들고 들어오는 사람은 우리 둘 다 못 봤어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#429.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#430.src: It would have had to have already been in {p} or they would have had to have arrived even before us.
Celebrations in Smoke#430.dst: 원래 {p}에 있었거나, 우리보다도 먼저 도착했어야 해요.
Celebrations in Smoke#430.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#431.src: A broken bottle? It looks kind of like the ones we use for our Bottles of Mist, but the smell is totally different.
Celebrations in Smoke#431.dst: 깨진 병이요? 우리 안개 병에 쓰는 병이랑 좀 닮았는데, 냄새가 완전히 달라요.
Celebrations in Smoke#431.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#432.src: Whoa, that's super cool! I bet those pointy edges could hurt a changeling pretty bad...
Celebrations in Smoke#432.dst: 우와, 완전 멋지다! 저 뾰족한 모서리면 변신자한테 꽤 아프겠다...
Celebrations in Smoke#432.speaker: Excited Child

Celebrations in Smoke#433.src: Recognize it? No, but I wish I did!
Celebrations in Smoke#433.speaker: Excited Child

Celebrations in Smoke#434.src: That smell... I don't recognize it, I'm afraid. It certainly doesn't smell safe!
Celebrations in Smoke#434.dst: 그 냄새... 유감이지만 모르겠어요. 확실히 안전한 냄새는 아니네요!
Celebrations in Smoke#434.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#435.src: I don't recognize it. Would you mind putting it away though? The smell appears to be bothering a couple of the foxes.
Celebrations in Smoke#435.dst: 모르겠어요. 그런데 좀 치워 주실래요? 냄새 때문에 여우 몇 마리가 불편해하는 것 같아요.
Celebrations in Smoke#435.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#437.src: It's vaguely familiar to me, but I'm sorry to say I can't place where from.
Celebrations in Smoke#437.dst: 어렴풋이 낯익은데, 미안하지만 어디서 봤는지 모르겠어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#437.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#438.src: Whatever it is though, I certainly didn't bring it here.
Celebrations in Smoke#438.dst: 그게 뭐든, 제가 가져온 건 절대 아니에요.
Celebrations in Smoke#438.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#439.src: aUm, no, I don't think so.
Celebrations in Smoke#439.dst: 음, 아뇨, 못 본 것 같아요.
Celebrations in Smoke#439.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#440.src: Sorry if you were hoping I had.
Celebrations in Smoke#440.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#443.src: There's not much distinctive about it though, except for that odor.
Celebrations in Smoke#443.dst: 그 냄새 말고는 딱히 특징도 없고요.
Celebrations in Smoke#443.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#444.src: No. And we're in the middle of a conversation, please don't interrupt us.
Celebrations in Smoke#444.dst: 아니. 그리고 우리 지금 얘기 중이니까 끼어들지 마.
Celebrations in Smoke#444.speaker: Clan Member

Celebrations in Smoke#445.src: That bottle? Absolutely not, that smell is much more than what this old body could take.
Celebrations in Smoke#445.dst: 그 병? 전혀 모르오. 그 냄새는 이 늙은 몸이 견딜 수 없구려.
Celebrations in Smoke#445.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#447.src: But they paid me pretty good not to say!
Celebrations in Smoke#447.dst: 그런데 말하지 말라고 꽤 두둑이 받았거든!
Celebrations in Smoke#447.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#448.src: The only way I would is if I were to really be impressed by someone.
Celebrations in Smoke#448.dst: 말해 줄 방법은 누가 날 정말 감탄시키는 것뿐이지.
Celebrations in Smoke#448.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#450.src: Ha! I knew you couldn't do it.
Celebrations in Smoke#450.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#451.src: No hard feelings, nobody can expect to beat me at fox racing though.
Celebrations in Smoke#451.dst: 기분 나빠하지 마. 여우 경주에서 날 이길 거라곤 아무도 기대 안 하니까.
Celebrations in Smoke#451.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#452.src: Of course, if you want to try again, you're free to. Just don't be surprised when you get the same result.
Celebrations in Smoke#452.dst: 물론 다시 해 보고 싶으면 얼마든지. 결과가 같아도 놀라지나 마.
Celebrations in Smoke#452.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#454.src: You won!? I-I-I've never been beaten!
Celebrations in Smoke#454.dst: 이겼다고!? 나, 난 진 적이 없는데!
Celebrations in Smoke#454.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#455.src: I don't even know how that's possible, you looked like you were just picking randomly!
Celebrations in Smoke#455.dst: 대체 어떻게 된 거야, 그냥 아무거나 고르는 것 같았는데!
Celebrations in Smoke#455.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#456.src: Well, fair is fair. You gave me a good show, I'll tell you what I know.
Celebrations in Smoke#456.dst: 뭐, 약속은 약속이지. 좋은 구경 시켜 줬으니 아는 걸 말해 줄게.
Celebrations in Smoke#456.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#457.src: It's really not that big of a deal, I'm not sure why they paid me to stay quiet about it.
Celebrations in Smoke#457.dst: 사실 별일 아니야. 왜 입막음하려고 돈을 줬는지 모르겠어.
Celebrations in Smoke#457.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#458.src: While studying the foxes before the races started, I caught some members of the Kalkalrah clan bringing in bottles like those.
Celebrations in Smoke#458.dst: 경주 전에 여우들을 살피다가, Kalkalrah 씨족 몇 명이 저런 병을 들여오는 걸 봤어.
Celebrations in Smoke#458.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#459.src: I thought they were just green tea, but clearly they're not!
Celebrations in Smoke#459.dst: 그냥 녹차인 줄 알았는데, 확실히 아니네!
Celebrations in Smoke#459.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#460.src: I'm not positive where they are now, but I think I saw them head up the zipline to the second floor of {p}?
Celebrations in Smoke#460.dst: 지금 어디 있는진 모르겠는데, 짚라인 타고 {p} 2층으로 올라간 것 같아.
Celebrations in Smoke#460.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#461.src: And if you'd teach me your racing technique at some point, I'd really appreciate it!
Celebrations in Smoke#461.dst: 그리고 언제 네 경주 비법 좀 가르쳐 주면 정말 고맙겠어!
Celebrations in Smoke#461.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#462.src: Be careful with the accusations you throw around.
Celebrations in Smoke#462.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#463.src: Not everyone has their guard down around this festival for those who stick their noses where they don't belong.
Celebrations in Smoke#463.dst: 남의 일에 코를 들이미는 자들 앞에서 축제라고 다들 경계를 푸는 건 아니거든.
Celebrations in Smoke#463.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#464.src: Give me that, let me look at what you were showing them more closely.
Celebrations in Smoke#464.dst: 그걸 이리 주시오. 저들에게 보여 준 걸 좀 더 자세히 봐야겠소.
Celebrations in Smoke#464.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#465.src: Ahhh, yes, you know something about that group, don't you?
Celebrations in Smoke#465.dst: 아아, 그렇지. 저 무리에 대해 뭔가 알고 있구려?
Celebrations in Smoke#465.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#466.src: You don't need to tell me, I know as much as you do and more.
Celebrations in Smoke#466.dst: 말할 필요 없소. 난 당신만큼, 아니 그 이상 알고 있으니.
Celebrations in Smoke#466.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#467.src: It's been many years since I was able to freely move about the city, my old age imprisoning me in my home.
Celebrations in Smoke#467.dst: 늙어서 집에 갇힌 뒤로 도시를 자유롭게 다니지 못한 지 여러 해가 됐소.
Celebrations in Smoke#467.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#468.src: But I can still sit and watch the scurrying people below. I can see what they all do when they think nobody is watching.
Celebrations in Smoke#468.dst: 하지만 아직 앉아서 아래 분주한 사람들을 볼 수는 있소. 아무도 안 본다고 여길 때 뭘 하는지 다 보이지.
Celebrations in Smoke#468.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#469.src: It's a sort of power. A way to keep myself grounded, hanging here in the canopy.
Celebrations in Smoke#469.dst: 일종의 힘이오. 이 나무 꼭대기에 매달려서도 중심을 잡는 방법이지.
Celebrations in Smoke#469.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#470.src: I watched you scramble to extinguish the fire and I watched what that group did after the flame was lit.
Celebrations in Smoke#470.dst: 당신이 허둥지둥 불을 끄는 것도, 불이 붙은 뒤 저 무리가 한 짓도 다 봤소.
Celebrations in Smoke#470.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#471.src: I watched as those three outsiders were corralled into custody.
Celebrations in Smoke#471.dst: 외부인 셋이 붙잡혀 구금되는 것도 봤소.
Celebrations in Smoke#471.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#472.src: However, I cannot hear the details. I do not know the specifics.
Celebrations in Smoke#472.dst: 하지만 자세한 말은 들리지 않소. 구체적인 건 모르지.
Celebrations in Smoke#472.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#473.src: Tell me what your suspects have done and what you have found. Then, I will give you what you seek.
Celebrations in Smoke#473.dst: 용의자들이 뭘 했고 당신이 뭘 찾았는지 말해 보시오. 그럼 원하는 걸 주겠소.
Celebrations in Smoke#473.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#474.src: A bunch of lying outsiders then. To be expected, it's a pity you can't say they all did it.
Celebrations in Smoke#474.dst: 거짓말쟁이 외부인들이로군. 예상대로요. 셋 다 범인이라 할 수 없는 게 아쉽구려.
Celebrations in Smoke#474.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#475.src: As for that clique, I suspect they're secretly security for the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#475.dst: 저 패거리는 아마 축제의 비밀 경비대일 거요.
Celebrations in Smoke#475.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#476.src: I didn't see who lit the flame, but moments after it was lit, one of them threw a bottle just like the one you're holding at it.
Celebrations in Smoke#476.dst: 누가 불을 붙였는지는 못 봤지만, 불이 붙고 곧 저들 중 하나가 당신이 든 것과 똑같은 병을 거기 던졌소.
Celebrations in Smoke#476.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#477.src: It must have been filled with fuel, because after it hit the flame grew much larger.
Celebrations in Smoke#477.dst: 연료가 들어 있었던 게지. 병이 맞자 불길이 훨씬 커졌으니.
Celebrations in Smoke#477.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#478.src: Probably for the best, you never know what vermin you can roast if you're not afraid to burn the bush.
Celebrations in Smoke#478.dst: 잘된 일일지도 모르오. 덤불 태우길 겁내지 않으면 무슨 해충이 구워질지 모르는 법이니.
Celebrations in Smoke#478.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#479.src: If you will entertain an old woman, then I have no use for you. Quit blocking my view.
Celebrations in Smoke#479.dst: 늙은이 말동무나 하려는 거라면 볼일 없소. 앞 좀 가리지 마시오.
Celebrations in Smoke#479.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#480.src: My investigator has returned. Now, tell me what you know.
Celebrations in Smoke#480.dst: 내 조사관이 돌아왔구려. 자, 아는 걸 말해 보시오.
Celebrations in Smoke#480.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#481.src: You look like you have something on your mind, what is it?
Celebrations in Smoke#481.dst: 뭔가 생각하는 게 있어 보이네요. 뭔가요?
Celebrations in Smoke#481.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#482.src: Ah, I see your investigations have borne fruit.
Celebrations in Smoke#482.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#483.src: Yes. As you have seen, people tend to let their guard down at the festival in a way they normally wouldn't.
Celebrations in Smoke#483.dst: 네. 보셨듯이 사람들은 축제 때 평소와 달리 경계를 늦추곤 하죠.
Celebrations in Smoke#483.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#484.src: They are a necessity to ensure any unexpected guests are swiftly taken care of.
Celebrations in Smoke#484.dst: 불청객을 신속히 처리하려면 꼭 필요한 이들이에요.
Celebrations in Smoke#484.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#485.src: I suspect you're probably right. And yet, that is irrelevant.
Celebrations in Smoke#485.dst: 아마 당신 말이 맞을 거예요. 하지만 그건 상관없어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#485.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#486.src: You will tell me they are reckless and a danger to others. I don't disagree, but I encourage you to look at the wider picture.
Celebrations in Smoke#486.dst: 그들이 무모하고 남에게 위험하다고 하시겠죠. 저도 동의하지만, 더 넓게 보시길 권해요.
Celebrations in Smoke#486.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#487.src: If we let up our vigilance for even a moment, we have already lost our war. Our clans and families will be infiltrated within the day.
Celebrations in Smoke#487.dst: 한순간이라도 경계를 늦추면 이미 전쟁에서 진 거예요. 씨족과 가족에 하루 만에 침투당하겠죠.
Celebrations in Smoke#487.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#488.src: Their recklessness prevents this. In a case where the smallest failure would be a catastrophe, recklessness becomes necessity.
Celebrations in Smoke#488.dst: 그들의 무모함이 그걸 막아요. 사소한 실패도 재앙이 되는 상황에선 무모함이 필수가 되죠.
Celebrations in Smoke#488.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#489.src: Imagine they had not acted rashly in throwing the bottle of fuel onto the already lit flame.
Celebrations in Smoke#489.dst: 그들이 이미 붙은 불에 연료병을 성급히 던지지 않았다고 상상해 보세요.
Celebrations in Smoke#489.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#490.src: They did not create the flame, someone else must have been hoping to gain from it.
Celebrations in Smoke#490.dst: 불은 그들이 낸 게 아니에요. 다른 누군가가 그걸로 이득을 보려 했겠죠.
Celebrations in Smoke#490.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#491.src: Their actions, while dangerous, prevented any fiends from exploiting the opportunity. We took it out of their control.
Celebrations in Smoke#491.dst: 위험하긴 해도, 그 행동 덕에 어떤 악당도 기회를 이용하지 못했어요. 주도권을 빼앗은 거죠.
Celebrations in Smoke#491.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#492.src: Whatever risk their actions created was worth the price.
Celebrations in Smoke#492.dst: 그로 인한 위험이 뭐든 그만한 대가를 치를 가치가 있었어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#492.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#493.src: Apologies for rambling, I assure you though that safety is our top concern. Whatever the price.
Celebrations in Smoke#493.dst: 말이 길어져 죄송해요. 하지만 안전이 최우선이라는 건 약속드려요. 대가가 뭐든요.
Celebrations in Smoke#493.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#494.src: Return to the festival organizer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or look into the suspects a bit more.
Celebrations in Smoke#494.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 축제 주최자에게 돌아가거나 용의자들을 좀 더 조사하세요.

Celebrations in Smoke#495.src: You think you know who the changeling is?
Celebrations in Smoke#495.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#496.src: You've dug into them all and have found something? Excellent.
Celebrations in Smoke#496.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#497.src: So, who do you think tried to burn down the wickerman?
Celebrations in Smoke#497.dst: 그럼, 누가 위커맨을 태우려 했다고 보세요?
Celebrations in Smoke#497.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#498.src: Suspect {~}? Very well. I will take care of things from here.
Celebrations in Smoke#498.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#499.src: Again, thank you so much for your help. I cannot emphasize enough how much you assisting in this matter for us allowed the festival to be a success.
Celebrations in Smoke#499.dst: 다시 한번 도와주셔서 정말 고마워요. 이 일을 도와주신 덕에 축제가 성공할 수 있었다는 건 아무리 강조해도 부족해요.
Celebrations in Smoke#499.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#500.src: Enjoy the rest of the festival, and make sure to watch the wickerman burn! I'll save a special seat for you near the front as a sign of our appreciation.
Celebrations in Smoke#500.dst: 남은 축제 즐기시고, 위커맨이 타는 것도 꼭 보세요! 감사의 뜻으로 앞쪽에 특별석을 마련해 둘게요.
Celebrations in Smoke#500.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#501.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#502.dst: 다시 한번 도와주셔서 정말 고마워요. 이 일을 도와주신 덕에 축제가 성공할 수 있었다는 건 아무리 강조해도 부족해요.

Celebrations in Smoke#503.dst: 남은 축제 즐기시고, 위커맨이 타는 것도 꼭 보세요! 감사의 뜻으로 앞쪽에 특별석을 마련해 둘게요.
Celebrations in Smoke#503.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#504.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#506.dst: 남은 축제 즐기시고, 위커맨이 타는 것도 꼭 보세요! 감사의 뜻으로 앞쪽에 특별석을 마련해 둘게요.
Celebrations in Smoke#506.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#507.src: I understand your reticense to pick one. We don't have anything close to the information required to make a proper judgement.
Celebrations in Smoke#507.dst: 한 명을 고르기 망설이는 거 이해해요. 제대로 판단할 정보가 턱없이 부족하니까요.
Celebrations in Smoke#507.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#508.src: But you cannot allow that to stop you. We do not have the luxury to close our eyes and pretend it didn't happen.
Celebrations in Smoke#508.dst: 하지만 그 때문에 멈추면 안 돼요. 눈 감고 없던 일로 할 여유는 없어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#508.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#509.src: Please, from the inevitably incomplete investigation you conducted, tell me who you think lit that flame.
Celebrations in Smoke#509.dst: 부디, 불완전할 수밖에 없는 조사였더라도 누가 불을 붙였다고 보는지 말해 주세요.
Celebrations in Smoke#509.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#510.src: Very well then. I am disappointed, but understand.
Celebrations in Smoke#510.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#511.src: I will take care of things from this point forward.
Celebrations in Smoke#511.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#512.src: In thanks for saving the wickerman, there will be a seat saved for you when you are ready to watch it burn.
Celebrations in Smoke#512.dst: 위커맨을 구해 준 답례로, 타는 걸 보러 오실 때를 위해 자리를 맡아 둘게요.
Celebrations in Smoke#512.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#513.src: Enjoy the rest of the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#513.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#514.src: Keep looking then. Return here once you've made a decision.
Celebrations in Smoke#514.dst: 그럼 계속 조사하세요. 결정하시면 여기로 오세요.
Celebrations in Smoke#514.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#517.src: You children of the {p} gather round
Celebrations in Smoke#517.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#518.src: To gaze upon this relic from years past,
Celebrations in Smoke#518.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#519.src: This effigy, of ancient foes we fought—
Celebrations in Smoke#519.dst: 이 인형은 우리가 맞선 옛 적이니—
Celebrations in Smoke#519.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#520.src: In memory, we will again ignite!
Celebrations in Smoke#520.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#521.src: An ancient beast, rebuilt with plank and straw,
Celebrations in Smoke#521.dst: 판자와 짚으로 다시 지은 태고의 짐승,
Celebrations in Smoke#521.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#522.src: What once was flesh, reconstitute as wood;
Celebrations in Smoke#522.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#523.src: All monsters, old and new, must meet their end—
Celebrations in Smoke#523.dst: 옛것이든 새것이든 모든 괴물은 끝을 맞으리—
Celebrations in Smoke#523.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#524.src: All fiends must burn! Must broil and char and melt!
Celebrations in Smoke#524.dst: 모든 악귀는 불타라! 그을고 타고 녹아내려라!
Celebrations in Smoke#524.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#525.src: Substance beside, all that remains persists...
Celebrations in Smoke#525.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#526.src: ...as blackened corpse, no threat there can exist!
Celebrations in Smoke#526.dst: ...검게 탄 시신일 뿐, 거기엔 어떤 위협도 없으리!
Celebrations in Smoke#526.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#527.src: Oh, hi, I never got the chance to thank you.
Celebrations in Smoke#527.dst: 아, 안녕하세요. 감사 인사를 못 드렸었죠.
Celebrations in Smoke#527.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#528.src: I'm not sure what happened after you left.
Celebrations in Smoke#528.dst: 그쪽이 떠난 뒤에 무슨 일이 있었는지 잘 몰라요.
Celebrations in Smoke#528.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#529.src: The festival organizer came back and took Burick/Cerisa away with him.
Celebrations in Smoke#529.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#530.src: I'm not sure what happened but, um, I don't think it was good.
Celebrations in Smoke#530.dst: 무슨 일인지는 몰라도, 음, 좋은 일은 아니었던 것 같아요.
Celebrations in Smoke#530.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#531.src: So, thank you again. I wasn't really in the right mind enough to show it then.
Celebrations in Smoke#531.dst: 그러니 다시 고마워요. 그땐 정신이 없어서 제대로 표현을 못 했어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#531.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#533.src: I'll see how long I can hang around here, but the locals are beginning to glare at me a bit.
Celebrations in Smoke#533.dst: 여기 얼마나 머물 수 있을지 볼게요. 근데 동네 사람들이 절 좀 째려보기 시작했어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#533.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#534.src: I might try to head deeper into the woods, see if there's anything I can find.
Celebrations in Smoke#534.dst: 숲 깊숙이 들어가서 뭘 찾을 수 있는지 볼까 해요.
Celebrations in Smoke#534.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#535.src: Or join the military? I don't think I'd be very good at it and I don't even think they'd accept me, but it might be worth a shot.
Celebrations in Smoke#535.dst: 아니면 입대할까요? 잘할 것 같지도 않고 받아 줄지도 모르겠지만, 해 볼 만할지도요.
Celebrations in Smoke#535.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#536.src: Otherwise, all I can do is try to live off of what I can find. I, uh, don't like my chances with that.
Celebrations in Smoke#536.dst: 아니면 찾은 걸로 버티며 사는 수밖에요. 전, 어, 그건 가망 없을 것 같아요.
Celebrations in Smoke#536.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#537.src: I am! I'm always a, uh, little nervous. But a lot less than I was.
Celebrations in Smoke#537.dst: 괜찮아요! 늘, 어, 좀 긴장하긴 하지만요. 그래도 전보단 훨씬 덜해요.
Celebrations in Smoke#537.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#538.src: It felt like the axe that had been pressed against my neck was lifted, thanks to you.
Celebrations in Smoke#538.dst: 그쪽 덕분에 목에 대고 있던 도끼가 치워진 기분이었어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#538.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#539.src: There's still a lot of uncertainty, but I no longer feel like I'm scrambling like a rabbit in a cage.
Celebrations in Smoke#539.dst: 아직 불확실한 게 많지만, 우리 안에서 허둥대는 토끼 같은 기분은 이제 안 들어요.
Celebrations in Smoke#539.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#540.src: I was still in a bit of a daze, so not really, sorry.
Celebrations in Smoke#540.dst: 아직 좀 멍한 상태여서, 딱히요. 죄송해요.
Celebrations in Smoke#540.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#541.src: She left pretty quick though, she must have been in a hurry to get somewhere
Celebrations in Smoke#541.dst: 그래도 그분은 꽤 빨리 떠났어요. 어딘가 급히 가야 했나 봐요
Celebrations in Smoke#541.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#543.src: Hello. Please try not to come too close.
Celebrations in Smoke#543.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#544.src: We can talk from a distance.
Celebrations in Smoke#544.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#545.src: Apologies for the coolness, your help was appreciated.
Celebrations in Smoke#545.dst: 냉랭해서 미안하오. 도와준 건 고맙게 여기오.
Celebrations in Smoke#545.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#546.src: But I cannot be sure you are who you say you are.
Celebrations in Smoke#546.dst: 하지만 당신이 말하는 그 사람이 맞는지 확신할 수 없소.
Celebrations in Smoke#546.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#548.src: Since our run in at the festival, I have been laying lower than usual.
Celebrations in Smoke#548.dst: 축제에서 그 일이 있은 뒤로, 평소보다 더 몸을 숨기고 있소.
Celebrations in Smoke#548.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#549.src: My life has not been much different than it usually is.
Celebrations in Smoke#549.dst: 내 삶은 평소와 크게 다르지 않소.
Celebrations in Smoke#549.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#550.src: It was a horrific mistake to even attend the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#550.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#551.src: I allowed myself to be controlled by my own humanity; that is a mistake the {p} rarely lets off easily.
Celebrations in Smoke#551.dst: 내 안의 인간미에 휘둘렸던 거요. {p}은(는) 그런 실수를 쉽게 봐주지 않소.
Celebrations in Smoke#551.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#552.src: I will not make the same mistake again. Loneliness will hurt, but trust will kill.
Celebrations in Smoke#552.dst: 같은 실수는 다시 안 하오. 외로움은 아프지만, 신뢰는 목숨을 앗아가지.
Celebrations in Smoke#552.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#553.src: Last I saw, they were still in {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#553.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#554.src: They don't seem cut out for the life of a scavenger, if they can't find any other way to live outside a clan they'll be dead within the week.
Celebrations in Smoke#554.dst: 떠돌이 채집꾼으로 살 사람 같지 않소. 씨족 밖에서 살 다른 방법을 못 찾으면 일주일 안에 죽을 거요.
Celebrations in Smoke#554.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#556.src: Yes, while everyone else was watching the wickerman burn she rustled through as many abandoned stalls, bags, and houses as she could.
Celebrations in Smoke#556.dst: 그렇소. 다들 위커맨이 타는 걸 볼 때, 그 여자는 버려진 가판대며 가방이며 집을 닥치는 대로 뒤졌소.
Celebrations in Smoke#556.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#557.src: I left before she was finished, but this morning I saw a figure walking south out of {p}, carrying several large bags.
Celebrations in Smoke#557.dst: 다 끝나기 전에 떠났는데, 오늘 아침 큰 가방 여러 개를 멘 사람이 {p}에서 남쪽으로 나가는 걸 봤소.
Celebrations in Smoke#557.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#558.src: Wherever she's headed, she's prepared for a long trek.
Celebrations in Smoke#558.dst: 어디로 가든, 긴 여정을 단단히 준비했더군.
Celebrations in Smoke#558.speaker: Burick
